title: On a maximal anti-Ramsey conjecture of Burr, Erdős, Graham, and Sós
summary: Given a graph $H$, the maximal anti-Ramsey function $f(n,e,H)$ denotes the minimum integer $f$ for which there exists an $n$-vertex graph $G$ with at least $e$ edges admitting an edge-coloring with $f$ colors in which each copy of $H$ in $G$ is rainbow. In the late 1980s, Burr, Erdős, Graham, and Sós conjectured that for every odd cycle $C_{2k+1}$ with $k \ge 3$, $f(n, \lfloor n^2/4 \rfloor + 1, C_{2k+1}) = n^2/8 + o(n^2)$.
